notes.title: FACE LOVE: Face Designer coming to Steam for FREE
notes.content:
SURPRISE! Our character-builder game FACE LOVE is coming to Steam for FREE!

There's tons of new features, like creative mode, character renaming, and OVER 200+ FACE PARTS TO BUILD YOUR PERFECT FREAK!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753427/ed8fd67269fec66313c188609ac00c8a17f83f4a.png
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3401050/FACE_LOVE_Face_Designer/

notes.title: GREAT GOD GROVE is OUT NOW!!!

notes.title: Smile For Me has been updated!
notes.content:
Finally, we’re excited to announce that Smile for Me has been updated! This patch brings quality of life features to all platforms, with graphical updates and motion control improvements for Nintendo Switch. Check it out today!

Updates to Steam:


 Added possibility to close pause menu with UI Back action.
 Added the possibility to close popups with UI Back action.
 Added delete save slot mode (delete on confirm button) when entering the saves menu with save slots full popup active.
 Added functionality that shows player inventory when it is hidden and use/scroll inventory button was - pressed.
 Added possibility to change language in main menu.
 Increased texture quality.

notes.title: Smile For Me Key Giveaway
notes.content:
ONE WEEK REMAINS, HABITICIANS!

Smile For Me comes to Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, and Xbox on April 24th, as well as additional languages on Steam! 

We're so excited to see you in the Habitat!

To celebrate, LimboLane and Serenity Forge are giving away digital Smile For Me keys for the console of your choice!


Entering the giveaway is simple: Post any Smile For Me art to Instagram, Tumblr, or Twitter by April 22nd. Tag it with #SmileForMeGame (Twitter, Instagram) or #Smile For Me Game (Tumblr). Six winners will be chosen at random, two each from Twitter, Instagram, and Tumblr!

Each unique art post from April 17th to April 22nd is eligible to win! Cross-posting the same piece on different platforms is allowed. Posting multiple pieces is also allowed, but each individual can only win one key!

Winners will be contacted at 9am PST on April 23rd and may choose a key for Switch, Xbox, or PlayStation. Make sure to have direct messages open April 23rd so we can contact you if you win!

SEE YOU IN THE HABITAT, SAD SACKS!

notes.title: SMILE FOR ME receives New Languages and PORTS April 24!
notes.content:
One month to go! On April 24th, Smile For Me will be available to play in 8 new languages on Steam.

With help from publisher Serenity Forge, existing owners and new buyers will be able to play the game in Japanese, Chinese (simplified and traditional), Korean, French, Spanish, Russian, German, and Portuguese!


There’s more news!
Also on April 24th, the game will arrive on Nintendo Switch, Playstation 5/4, Xbox S|X/One!
You can pre-order Smile For Me on the Nintendo Store or the Nintendo eShop to play it the day it releases!
You can also wishlist the game for Playstation 4/5.

Smile For Me will arrive on consoles April 24th with remastered audio and graphics, easter eggs, and all new language options.

Go to our official website for more details about the physical edition!


PSST- Did you know that we’re going to be in Boston March 23-25 for PAX East 2023? We would love to see you! LimboLane will be showing off Smile For Me on Nintendo Switch and giving away some original sketches by Yugo; plus other goodies! Visit the Serenity Forge booth (#10023) to say hi!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753427/23cf3eac38c675bbaf605280544a9789689d5c90.png

notes.title: Smile For Me Definitive Steam Update!
notes.content:
While preorders are open for Smile For Me on Consoles, players on Steam receive a FREE UPDATE TODAY!

The Bloom Update is the definitive version of Smile For Me, in partnership with publisher Serenity Forge.

Graphics have been updated, visuals improved, and in-game music has gotten a mouthwatering remaster! Smile For Me has never looked or sounded so tasty.
Controller support, new settings, and stability improvements make the game easier than ever to play.
Returning players also should keep an eye out for brand new art and easter eggs, hidden all around the Habitat. What will you discover?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753427/0e15de3e285249f18790ff983f141fe4260e17b2.png

THAT’S NOT ALL! The game’s DLC has gotten a big upgrade!
The Smile For Me Digital Soundtrack has been fully remastered, with 21 gorgeous music tracks - including Louie Zong’s delicious track from our brand new trailer!
The Smile For Me Digital Artbook also has oodles of new content, totaling over 100 pages. Never-before-seen concept art and commentary by developers Yugo Limbo and Day Lane provide insight into how this weird world was brought to life.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34753427/421cdf7efeed804e6a71e4b93bbe737f7ee7a016.png

When Smile For Me releases on consoles in Spring 2023, Steam users can look forward to new languages on PC! Smile For Me will be playable in French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese, Korean, and Japanese.

There’s tons to sink your teeth into. So bare your fangs, dust off your bouquet, and join your friends at The Habitat!



The Bloom Update is live now on Steam for Windows and MacOS.



We’ll be making updates and bugfixes as necessary in the coming weeks.
Contact support@serenityforge.com to report any update-related bugs or issues.

notes.title: $10,000 RAISED FOR BLACK LIVES MATTER!
notes.content:
Wow.

Last week, Smile For Me turned 1 year old. To celebrate, we released the interactive epilogue, telling the story of the habiticians one year later.

We also ran a big sale; the proceeds of which would be donated to Reclaim the Block and local bail funds for Black Lives Matter protestors.

We expected to raise a decent amount of money. Maybe $4,000? $5,000?

Instead, you raised over 10 thousand dollars for Black Lives Matter organizations!

On the first day of the sale, we sold more copies of Smile For Me than the day we first released. We're overjoyed that the money from those sales can go to a cause we support with all our heart.
Thousands of new players joined the community as existing players tweeted, made art, and spread kind words about the game. 

Since we released the game a year ago, we've been blown away by the love and kindness endemic to the Smile For Me community. We created the epilogue in order to thank you for the positivity you put into the world. By making this fundraiser a massive success, you proved again that the Smile For Me fans are the best fans.


We want to thank you for buying, sharing, and talking about the game; you helped us donate tons of money to some great organizations. You make us smile.

Keep on spreading love, and stay safe!

Sincerely
LimboLane

notes.title: ANNIVERSARY CHARITY SALE!
notes.content:
Dear Habiticians, of past present and future...
Smile For Me was released one year ago today. Today, we released the long-anticipated epilogue, in the form of an interactive webpage.

Smile For Today features brand new dialogue from all the Habiticians, and new music by Lucas Saur and EZIA.
Most importantly, it features a wide range of work from artists in the Smile For Me community, who have taken to heart the game’s message by being kind, generous, and surprising in their support of one another. The Habiticians have something to say to you. Why don’t you go see what the hubbub is all about?



Right now, the world is a scary place. We hope that you can use art to care for yourself and others. But we also ask that you do not turn a blind eye on the injustice and brutality that are inescapable for so many.
During this sale, all of the money we make will be given to Reclaim the Block, as well as local bail and relief funds.
We believe strongly that grassroots organizing is the most effective way to combat the deep hurt imposed on black and poc communities.

Let’s make this world better.


As a note:
Steam takes a 30% cut of game sales. If you get your steam key from itchio instead, every single cent will go to grassroots organizations.



From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for a year of kindness and community.
You make us smile.

Sincerely,
LimboLane

notes.title: New Patch - 2019.06.27
notes.content:
Hi All,
Just a small patch today to repair two issues that were reported to us.
Thanks for sticking with us and reporting issues!

Enjoy!

Changelist:
-Prevents progress loss after losing the second Whack-A-Molar game
-Increases texture legibility on low graphics settings

notes.title: New Patch - 2019.06.14
notes.content:
Hi all,
Thanks so much for sticking with us for the first 2 weeks of Smile For Me! The community has been amazing, and I hope it will continue to grow! Today's patch fixes a few non-critical bugs and makes some small adjustments. 

Due to popular demand, we've included an album cover in the soundtrack DLC for your collection! Enjoy!

Changelist:
-Adds album cover image to the soundtrack DLC
-Prevents the [spoiler]Lounge Door[/spoiler] from opening on the final day, sequence-breaking the game
-(Hopefully) fixes bug causing Putunia to consume the [spoiler]cape[/spoiler] item, softlocking the game
-Fixes exploit in the [spoiler]tower[/spoiler] that allows out-of-bounds movement
-Fixes typo in the start menu
-Minor visual improvements

notes.title: New Patch - 2019.06.05
notes.content:
Our second patch! This one has more quality of life changes and fixes some minor bugs. Thanks for sticking with us and continuing to communicate any issues with the game!

  Changelist: 
-Nat is less prone to sniff forever
-(Hopefully) allows nodding to Dallas after giving him a [spoiler]kiss[/spoiler]
-The Autosave file doesn’t update its timestamp when starting a new file
-Makes the indicator for skipping PSAs more obvious when the spacebar is held

-MAJOR FINALE SPOILER: When you are [spoiler]stuck to the chair[/spoiler] in the [spoiler]tower[/spoiler], allows [spoiler]Dr. Habit[/spoiler]’s dialogue to be fast-forwarded
-MAJOR FINALE SPOILER: When [spoiler]Habit[/spoiler] sends you back to the [spoiler]chair[/spoiler], you do not need to redo the [spoiler]button[/spoiler] puzzle

notes.title: Hotfix released
notes.content:
Hi All!

We've released a new hotfix to address a major bug with saved items. Some save files created since June 3rd have failed to save all of their items. This update should address and repair that bug. In the meantime, it is possible that in the last day and a half, a user might have ended up with a save file that is missing crucial items. We're very sorry if this happened to you, and please feel free to reach out to our support email if you think you're missing items or have questions about whether your save file is softlocked.

This is a precursor to a larger quality of life update which we will roll out tonight or early tomorrow.

Thanks for sticking with us, and sorry about any inconvenience.

Sincerely,
-LL

notes.title: New Patch - 2019.06.03
notes.content:
We’ve released the first patch for Smile For Me! Thanks for reporting bugs and helping us improve the game. We’re currently tracking more potential bugs, so keep support emails coming! 

Changelist:
-(Hopefully) fixes bug making it impossible to use the [spoiler]toothbrush[/spoiler] on Kamal. Please use the support link to send an email with details if this issue persists after updating your game.
-Starting a new game now backs up the existing Autosave first, to prevent accidentally overwriting progress
-Updates recipe sprite to say “3” mushrooms
-Wallus now reacts to the Photo of Tim Tam
-Fixes Kamal’s clue to the location of the [spoiler]toothbrush[/spoiler]
-Edits the “7” and “1” on [spoiler]Habit’s[/spoiler] wall to be more easily distinguishable
-Updates Gillis’s photo to show his full name
